encryptionKey.label: Encryption key
encryptionKey.description: Needed only when the board is encrypted, that is when its YAML has api: encryption: key:. Copy the base64 value from there. Leave it empty for an unencrypted board; CamStack then tries to read the key from the ESPHome Builder in Home Assistant.

password.label: Legacy API password
password.description: Only for a board that predates encryption and has api: password:.
